traditional: 當 A 係細路咁管
jyutping: dong1 A hai6 sai3 lou6 gam3 gun2

english.note: Use this colloquial construction when you want to spell out the controlling behavior, treating subordinates as if they were children.

examples.english: The boss is so paternalistic that they have to interfere in everything.
examples.traditional: 個老闆成日當我哋係細路咁管，乜都要親自插手。
